gha-28-persist-credentials: step "Check out the repository" in job "build" checks out without persist-credentials: false, leaving the token in .git/config for every later step; add with: {persist-credentials: false}

gha-30-concurrency-group: the concurrency group "pr-${{ github.event.number }}" does not start with the standard prefix; set concurrency: {group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}", cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}} so a newer push supersedes an older run of the same ref
gha-31-callable-concurrency: the workflow is triggered only by workflow_call yet declares concurrency; inside a called workflow github.workflow is the caller's name, so callers share one group and cancel each other; remove concurrency: and let the caller set it
gha-32-paths-filter: on.pull_request has a paths filter, but this workflow emits a required check; when the filter skips the run the check never reports and the pull request cannot merge; remove the filter and skip work inside the jobs instead
gha-38-kebab-case-io: input "tool_version" is not kebab-case; rename it to "tool-version" and update every inputs.tool_version reference

gha-40-slim-docker: job "build" runs on ubuntu-slim but step "Build the image" runs Docker, and that runner has no Docker; run it on ubuntu-24.04

gha-42-actions-cache: step "Build the image" in job "build" uses the type=gha build cache in its cache-from input; Docker layers fill the repository's 10 GB Actions cache and evict every other cache, so keep the build cache in a registry (type=registry) instead

rel-03-release-type-input: step "release" in job "release_please" passes release-type, which makes release-please ignore its config and release-please manifest; remove it and set release-type in .github/release-please/config.json
rel-04-unversioned-package: the release-please manifest has no version for package "."; add ".": "<its current version>" so release-please does not release its history again
rel-05-component-tag: the release-please config tags the only package with its component; set "include-component-in-tag": false so tags read vX.Y.Z
rel-06-release-title: the release-please config titles release pull requests "chore: release ${version}"; set "pull-request-title-pattern": "chore(release): release${component} ${version}" so every release pull request reads the same
rel-07-published-release: the release-please config does not set "draft": true; release-please must create each release as a draft, with its tag, so the assets are attached before the release is published and becomes immutable

the release-please config does not set "force-tag-creation": true; release-please must create each release as a draft, with its tag, so the assets are attached before the release is published and becomes immutable
rel-08-pre-major-bump: package "." is before 1.0 and does not set "bump-patch-for-minor-pre-major": true; in 0.x a breaking change bumps the minor version and anything else bumps the patch
rel-09-visible-chore: the release-please config's changelog shows "chore", so a chore commit cuts a release; mark its section hidden: true
rel-10-release-as: package "." still sets "release-as", which pins every later release; remove it now that the release it was for is cut, and pin a version with a Release-As: commit footer instead
rel-12-unprotected-tags: no active tag ruleset in .github/rulesets/ covers refs/tags/v1.0.0, so anyone who can push may create, move or delete it; add one with target "tag" whose ref_name includes refs/tags/v*
rel-13-admin-bypass: the tag ruleset protecting release tags lets a OrganizationAdmin bypass it; only the release App (actor_type "Integration") may create a release tag
rel-15-second-release-workflow: step "Refresh the release pull request's notes" in job "notes" runs release-please outside release.yml; run it only in .github/workflows/release.yml, so one workflow owns release pull requests, tags and releases
rel-16-legacy-app-id: step "app_token" in job "release_please" mints the release token with app-id rather than client-id; mint it from the release App with client-id: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_CLIENT_ID }}, private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }} and a permission-* input for each permission the job needs

step "app_token" in job "release_please" mints the release token with private-key "${{ secrets.AUTOMATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}"; mint it from the release App with client-id: ${{ vars.RELEASE_APP_CLIENT_ID }}, private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }} and a permission-* input for each permission the job needs
rel-17-upload-after-publish: step "Upload the extra assets to the published release" in job "assets" writes to a release from a workflow started by a release event, when the release is already published and its assets can no longer change; attach assets to the draft in release.yml, and push only to other registries here
rel-18-private-without-checksums: job "assets" uploads release assets without a SHA256SUMS file; write SHA256SUMS over the assets and upload it with them, so a consumer can verify each download
rel-18-unattested-assets: job "assets" uploads release assets without attesting them through a SHA256SUMS file; write SHA256SUMS over the assets, upload it with them, and attest it with actions/attest subject-checksums: <dir>/SHA256SUMS (a private or internal repository, where GitHub offers no attestations, declares visibility in .repo/repository.toml and needs only SHA256SUMS)
rel-19-default-token-publish: step "Publish the draft release" in job "finalize" publishes the draft release with ${{ github.token }}; publish it with the release App's token, since a release published by the default token starts no workflow on its published event
rel-20-no-dispatch: release.yml attaches assets to releases but cannot be dispatched for one; add workflow_dispatch with a required tag input, so a draft left by a failed run can be completed with the fixed workflow
repo-01-undeclared: the repository does not declare its identity; add .repo/repository.toml with its name, system, component, kind, owner, lifecycle, audience and tier
repo-02-invalid-declaration: `tier`: Must be less than or equal to 3.
repo-03-unregistered-kind: kind "microservice" is not a registered kind; use one of "content", "documentation", "infrastructure", "library", "service", "specification", "template", "tool", "website"
repo-04-name-mismatch: name is "platform-api", but system and component make "platform-server"; a repository's name is <system>-<component>, so correct whichever is wrong
repo-07-actual-name: the declaration names the repository "platform-api", but it is "platform-web"; set name to "platform-web", with system and component to match, or rename the repository and its declaration together
repo-08-grammar: repository name "platform-API" is not lowercase kebab-case; rename it to "platform-api"
repo-08-legacy-name: repository name "gadgets" is not <system>-<component>: a registered system, a hyphen and a component, in lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
repo-09-unregistered-system: the declaration names the repository "platform-api", but it is "widgets-api"; set name to "widgets-api", with system and component to match, or rename the repository and its declaration together

repository name "widgets-api" starts with "widgets", which is not a registered system; start it with one of "brand", "catalog", "company", "engineering", "host", "infra", "observability", "platform", "sdk"
repo-10-banned-token: repository name "platform-api-v2" holds the token "v2". Names a version, which changes while the name must not; drop the token and version what the repository publishes instead.
repo-11-long-name: repository name "platform-organization-membership-reconciler" is 43 characters, more than 40; shorten the component so the name stays readable in paths, image names and URLs
repo-14-no-layout: the identity declaration does not say where the product lives; add [layout] with product = "<repository-name>", or product = "" when the repository has no product directory
repo-15-missing-product: the declared product directory platform-api/ does not exist; create it, or correct [layout] product
repo-16-product-name: the product directory api/ is not named after the repository; rename it to platform-api/ and set [layout] product = "platform-api"
repo-17-no-manifest: platform-api/ holds no build manifest; move the product's manifest into it (one of Cargo.toml, build.gradle, build.gradle.kts, deno.json, deno.jsonc, go.mod, package.json, pom.xml, pyproject.toml, settings.gradle, settings.gradle.kts), or keep an OpenTofu root's .terraform.lock.hcl in it or in a directory below it
repo-18-root-content: go.sum is product content at the repository root; move it into platform-api/, or list it under [layout.root_exceptions] with the reason it stays
repo-19-exception-reason: the root exception "go.sum" gives no reason; say why it stays at the root, or remove the entry
repo-20-dependabot-root: the gomod update scans "/", the repository root, which holds no go.mod; set its directory to /platform-api
repo-21-product-dir-var: vars.PRODUCT_DIR is '{{.ROOT_DIR}}/.github'; set it to '{{.ROOT_DIR}}/platform-api' so tasks reach the product through dir: '{{.PRODUCT_DIR}}'
repo-22-dependabot-directory: the github-actions update names the directory "/.github/actions/setup", which does not exist; correct it, or remove it
repository-github-exempt: the repository publishes a site but has no Vale config to lint its copy; add .config/markdown/vale.ini that installs https://github.com/musher-dev/engineering-conventions/releases/download/v0.1.0/MusherProse.zip and applies MusherCopy, proselint, write-good to the site's sources
task-01-version: version is the number 3; quote it as version: '3', the schema version Task reads
task-02-variable-names: global variable "binaryName" is not UPPER_SNAKE; rename it "BINARY_NAME" and every reference to it
task-03-task-names: task name "docker_build" is not kebab-case; use lowercase words joined by hyphens, with `:` between a namespace and a name, such as "docker-build"
task-04-template-spaces: template {{ .BINARY }} has spaces inside its delimiters; write {{.BINARY}}
task-05-description: task "fmt" has no desc; add a one-line desc so task --list shows what it does
task-06-uncalled-internal: internal task "_generate" is called by no task; an internal task cannot be run on its own, so delete it or call it
task-07-prefix-output: task "deps" sets prefix, but no Taskfile that loads it sets output: prefixed, the only mode that prints it; set output: prefixed, or remove the prefix
task-08-dir-include-missing: variable LINT_CONFIG is "lint.yml", which names no file or directory in the repository; correct the path, or delete the variable
task-08-map-include-missing: variable LINT_CONFIG is "lint.yml", which names no file or directory in the repository; correct the path, or delete the variable
task-08-path-variable: variable LINT_CONFIG is ".golangci.yml", which names no file or directory in the repository; correct the path, or delete the variable
task-09-missing-include: include "docs" loads "./documentation", which does not exist; Task refuses to run any task until it does, so correct the path
task-10-no-taskfile: the repository has no root Taskfile; add Taskfile.yml defining "setup", "check", "lint", so `task <verb>` works the same in every repository
task-11-build-test: the root Taskfile does not define "build", "test"; add those tasks, or an alias of an existing task, so `task <verb>` works the same in every repository
task-12-dev: the root Taskfile does not define "dev"; add that task, or an alias of an existing task, so `task <verb>` works the same in every repository
task-14-missing-source: task "install" lists source "package.json", which does not exist; Task ignores a source that matches nothing, so the task stops noticing changes to it; correct the path or remove it
task-15-default-does-work: the default task calls task "build", so a bare `task` does work; make default only list the tasks (task --list) or run a help task that does, and give that work a name of its own
task-16-deep-name: task name "test:contract:openapi:public:v2" nests 4 namespaces; a name has at most three namespaces before it, so join words with hyphens instead, such as "test:contract:openapi:public-v2"
task-17-host-path: task "build" names "/workspaces/platform-api", a path on one machine, so the task breaks in any other checkout, container or CI runner; write it from {{.ROOT_DIR}} or {{.TASKFILE_DIR}}
task-18-unprompted-volume-wipe: task "stack:reset" takes a compose stack down with its volumes and declares no prompt:, so one mistyped command loses what nothing in the repository can restore; add a prompt naming what is lost (a workflow passes --yes)
tofu-01-no-repository: TOFU_STATE_KEY "tfstate/dns/terraform.tfstate" names no repository after tfstate/, so it is unique only by luck and says nothing of its owner; name the state key tfstate/platform-api/dns/terraform.tfstate, or tfstate/platform-api/dns/<env>/terraform.tfstate for a root split by environment, and migrate a used key rather than edit it
tofu-01-no-root: TOFU_STATE_KEY "tfstate/platform-api/terraform.tfstate" names no root, so a second root in the repository has nowhere to go; name the state key tfstate/platform-api/network/terraform.tfstate, or tfstate/platform-api/network/<env>/terraform.tfstate for a root split by environment, and migrate a used key rather than edit it
tofu-01-outside-tfstate: TOFU_STATE_KEY "platform-api/network/terraform.tfstate" is outside tfstate/, so retention rules and tools that scan tfstate/ miss it; name the state key tfstate/platform-api/network/terraform.tfstate, or tfstate/platform-api/network/<env>/terraform.tfstate for a root split by environment, and migrate a used key rather than edit it
tool-01-second-config: mise.toml is a mise configuration outside .config/mise/config.toml; move its settings and [tools] there and delete it, so one file pins every tool
tool-02-unqualified-backend: [tools] names "uv" without a backend, so mise's registry decides what it installs; name the backend, such as "aqua:<owner>/<repo>"
tool-03-floating-version: [tools] pins "node" to "lts", which resolves to a different release over time; pin one exact version, such as "1.2.3"
tool-04-min-version: the mise configuration sets no min_version, so an older mise loads it and may resolve it differently; set min_version to the mise version CI and the dev container install
tool-05-lockfile: no .config/mise/mise.lock beside the mise configuration, so each install resolves download URLs and checksums afresh; run `mise lock` and commit it
tool-06-floating-argument: ARG NODE_VERSION defaults to "24", which is not one release; set an exact version, such as NODE_VERSION=1.2.3
tool-07-runtime-image: node:22.1.0-slim runs node 22.1.0 but mise pins 24.21.0; use the 24.21.0 tag of node
tool-08-feature-version: Feature ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node:1 installs node lts but mise pins 24.21.0; set its version to 24.21.0
tool-09-package-manager: packageManager is bun@1.3.9 but mise pins bun 1.3.14; set packageManager to bun@1.3.14
tool-10-setup-action: step "install_node" installs node 22.1.0 with actions/setup-node but mise pins 24.21.0; set node-version: 24.21.0, or install it with jdx/mise-action
tool-11-tool-versions: .tool-versions is a second place to pin tool versions; move its pins to .config/mise/config.toml and delete it
tool-11-version-file: platform-api/.nvmrc says node 22 but mise pins 24.21.0; write 24.21.0, or delete the file if nothing but mise reads it
